name: isomorphic-webcrypto
description: Local shim package. lib0 (a yjs dependency) hard-requires isomorphic-webcrypto/src/react-native in React Native; this re-exports the already-polyfilled global.crypto (react-native-get-random-values) so no unmaintained native dep is needed. See apps/mobile/shims/lib0-webcrypto.js. Vendored (not the npm package) so Metro's DEFAULT resolver always finds it — independent of metro.config cache.
